parent.rule: SOL/BNB replication cannot rewrite or rescue the BTC/ETH result.

mechanism: Exact-rule replication of target-day weekday structure in one-day-ahead realized-variance forecasting.

exact_carryover.realized_variance: sum squared 5m close-to-close log returns on UTC day; accepted day >=270 returns
exact_carryover.HAR_DOW: baseline plus target-day Tue-Sun dummies, Monday base
exact_carryover.estimation: rolling previous 730 valid feature rows; minimum 500; daily re-estimation

family_interpretation.if_both_survive: Independent cross-asset replication supports a general intraweek variance-forecast mechanism.
family_interpretation.if_mixed: Keep BTC/ETH L5 result; do not manufacture pooled survival.
family_interpretation.if_both_fail: Cross-asset generality not supported; BTC/ETH result remains valid only for those assets.

no_rescue: No dropping SOL or BNB after outcomes.
No 2025 opening unless exact Discovery gate passes.
